dialogues.speaker: Tolstaya
dialogues.text: Of course it does! This is Miss Vodyanitsa, Miss Odette, and Mr. Alyosha's...

dialogues.speaker: Tolstaya
dialogues.text: #...Ah! Y-You're {NICKNAME}, aren't you? Miss Vodyanitsa told me about you.

dialogues.speaker: Tolstaya
dialogues.text: She said you have wonderful taste, and that you're a very kind person. This restaurant only looks as good as it does thanks to your help.
